STA Support Chat

Help-Center-grounded troubleshooting and customer-email drafts for the support team.
Try this: "A customer says their TT10 clocks stopped syncing after a network change. Draft a calm reply and list the first things I should check."

What it is

A shared Claude.ai Project for the support team that grounds product troubleshooting and customer-email drafting in the STA Help Center knowledge base, across 16 context files spanning the full product line.

What it does

Answers product questions, drafts customer replies, and explains fixes - always tied to source. It enforces a NEVER-FABRICATE hard rule and labels each answer Confirmed / Inferred / Unknown.

How to access

Sign in at claude.ai with your @k12sta.com email and open STA Support Chat in your Projects list.
